_note: Dark-store / hub points used by M4 two-ring inference (ARCHITECTURE.md §10). A locality inside innerKm is treated as available (source: seed, not probe). The 3–5 km ring is the edge we actually check. Beyond edgeKm we do not invent unavailable — we may not know every store yet. Coordinates are only written when we have a real geocode or a probe note we can place on a map. Do not treat this file as a complete store census.
